messages.subject: Rows vs columns
parts:
Hi TMBers

I have been experimenting with TMB, exploring various data extractions and manipulations, using a simple state space model I obtained at the Nov 2015 ICES course. In ADMB, I have been using time as rows and whatever variable as columns and wanted to do the same in TMB. In the TMB state space model, in the estimation of the likelihoods, when I tried to extract the u and obs variables by row using x.row(i), the program bombed. I had to transpose the u and obs arrays and then extract the data using x.col(i). All the relevant files are attached. In the wiki archive, a previous message by Kasper states that row extraction is expensive but I was surprised that it didn't work at all. 

Comments?

Bob

messages.author: 258b98968d0ad8b9
messages.subject: Re: Rows vs columns
parts:
You could use matrices instead of arrays:

* Replace "_ARRAY" by "_MATRIX".
* Replace "obs.dim(0)" by "obs.rows()".
* Replace "obs.dim(1)" by "obs.cols()".

That should work.
